main.description: Turn a Windows metafile (EMF, EMF+ or WMF), which Word and PowerPoint keep pasted figures as and no browser can draw, into a picture: SVG where the figure can be drawn as shapes and real text, PNG otherwise. The metafile is the body; the caller already holds it, having opened the document to find it, so this reads no storage. A session is asked for only so that this is not a conversion service for whoever finds the URL.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: Not a metafile, or one the renderer does not cover. The viewer falls back to a placeholder.
